Upper Text: ＜Evade＞ ＜Decode (Lv.5 or lower w/[Aqua]/[Sea Animal] in any trait)＞

[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 Digimon card with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits from your hand as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, 1 of your Digimon unsuspends.

[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When effects add to this Digimon's digivolution cards, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as many or fewer digivolution cards as this Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
